description: Parsing typed dates (chronology-engine §10.1) in the japanese-eras calendar: the texts of the formatting vectors read back, plus spacing, case, alternative names, eras and failures.
verification: Expected values produced by the engine and reviewed: each text taken from formatting/japanese-eras.json must give back that case’s precision and the start of the unit containing its moment (the formatting moment itself where it is a unit start), with the fields the text names; extra cases were checked by hand against the §10.1 rules.
